summary: 1. Sep 27 total production landed at 17,298 BCM against a 21,767.2 BCM target (-20.53%), but ore reversed sharply, beating its target by 108.27% — the largest ore beat this fiscal cycle has logged, following Sep 26's -84.34% miss. 2. 2. Crusher stockpile-to-crusher MTD throughput reached 4.71% of the 124,000 LCM monthly plan, up from Sep 26's 3.79%, on a day with 7h14m of combined crusher downtime, the longest single stop a 5h15m stockpile-full stoppage (1:45-6:30 PM). 3. 3. Excavator daily availability fell to 52.38%, the cycle's worst reading yet, with EX-123 and EX-253 both still down the full 24 hours (sixth and twelfth consecutive days) and two fresh stops opening the same day: EX-247 (Engine Cut Off, 12.5h, 47.92% avail) and EX-398 (planned welding job plus 500-hour service, 17.5h, 27.08% avail). 4. See [[daily-production-report]] and [[fleet-availability-utilization]]. 5. DT-131 and DT-243 both open fresh tire breakdowns the same day (Tyre #03 Problem and Tyre Flat #03, both from 5:30 AM, both 0.00% avail) — a second front of tire trouble alongside DT-344's carried-over Tire Puncher #04 fault, adding pressure to the standing 11-tire repair-supplier backlog and the 42-unit Michelin stock level already tracked in [[fleet-availability-utilization]]. 6. DT-107 and DT-128 remain down on matching Engine Coolant Temperature High faults, now on their fourth and tenth consecutive days respectively — no movement visible in today's Availability Report despite the engine-swap and cylinder-head-removal work described in the prior pass's maintenance updates. 7. MTD production sits at 46,779 BCM against a 54,418 BCM target (-14.04%), production day 3 of 30 in the 25-Sep-24-Oct fiscal cycle, days remaining 27. 8. Week-to-date -14.24% on total BCM but +78.51% on ore. 9. No new daily INX-SUM survey workbook landed this pass — the newest file remains `260927-INX-SUM.xlsx`, already registered and compiled in the prior pass as Sep 26 data. [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] is unchanged this pass; Sep 27's own survey reading is due on a future pass. Two new Project Finances items (`Budget 2027.msg`, `Clint Relationship .msg`) landed in RAW but were not registered this pass — they fall under the Important References workflow, which this dashboard-scoped task does not run, and the KB's own rule flags incoming financial/contract-terms material for review before ingest. Flagged for Peter or a future full-scope pass. No same-day HOD or HSE meeting note had landed in RAW as of this pass, so the fleet section carries no meeting-note corroboration this time. Tasks: none created this pass. The DT-131/DT-243 tire breakdowns and the unregistered Project Finances files are logged as open items in the affected articles/this entry rather than dispatched as action items. Important References, Notes & References, and Task Feedback Log workflows were not run this pass, per the task's own instructions. No content removed or renamed from RAW. ---
